verdict.rationale: CrewAI's docs say agents 'use tools to accomplish objectives' and define a tool as 'a skill or function that agents can utilize'. The CLI can scaffold a new tool project, and a community user built a working tool-calling crew, so custom tools on agents are supported. The pack does not show how custom tools are typed or that an agent with tools takes only a few lines of code; the only code sample is a short Crew definition. Missing for 10: evidence of typed tool definitions (schemas or typed arguments), a concise code example of an agent with a custom tool, independent hands-on corroboration of the custom-tool authoring experience.
